_doc: DISPOSE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-20: 'I don't want stuff sitting in the queue for months. Resolve it, close it. Everything has to run 100% server-side.'). The rules by which the fleet pass gives every open item a final recorded disposition within a bounded time, with no person and no code agent session. Consumer: foundation/dispose.py, called by foundation/queue.py run() on every fleet pass (.github/workflows/fleet.yml). A disposed item is closed with its rule and evidence in the item file; its closing probe keeps running (foundation/contracts.py) and marks it fixed when it passes; the executor retries shelved items when its open queue is empty (foundation/queue.py takeable).
gate_default: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it

dispositions.gate: only the owner's own account, money or signature can do it; closed with the default in effect
dispositions.shelved: no server-side loop closed it inside the limit; closed with the attempts as evidence and retried when the executor is idle
dispositions.fixed: the closing probe passed after the item was disposed

_ttl_hours: SLA-8H-1 (Rowan 2026-11-21: nothing open past 8 hours, ever). An open item older than ttl_hours is shelved (closed with evidence, retried when the executor is idle); the fleet pass runs every 10 minutes, so no item stays open past 8 hours. ttl_days is kept as the legacy bound only.
